critical_code_review_comments: mira_builder.py is now 745 lines — past the 700-line split threshold. Recommend splitting into: mira_builder_core.py (build/refine pipelines), mira_builder_studio.py (accounts/plans/buy), mira_builder_tools.py (upload-image/analyze/github-export), mira_builder_admin.py (super-admin).

GitHub export uses the raw PAT for a full pipeline (create repo + PUT contents). No retry on transient 5xx from GitHub, and the token stays in memory only — good. Consider adding an outbound audit log entry (project_id, repo, user_id, files_pushed) for security accountability.

_run_refine truncates html_src to 80000 chars — for a large refined site this could quietly drop the tail of the document. Consider a warning or a defensive fallback (LLM prompt hint) when truncation happens.

In upload-image, ext derivation `file.filename.rsplit('.', 1)[-1]` will pick the WHOLE filename when there's no dot (e.g. 'blob') — becomes the extension itself. Minor cosmetic issue but worth an `if '.' in filename else 'png'` guard.
studio_users tokens still share jwt_secret with salon-admin tokens (flagged in iter70). Adding an 'aud':'studio' claim + verification is a small, high-value hardening change.
